transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for 1 month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I have another question. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside is recommended.

But if the bright light causes significant pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside is recommended.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?
